summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of FASE 37 (Kalibrasi Sekali Klik). All critical paths tested successfully: calibration from Analytics panel recommendations, calibration from delay table rows, rollback functionality with validation, number honesty fix verification ('+N hari (geser rencana)' instead of '0 hari'), render regression across 5 major pages, and baseline restoration verification. Backend was already proven (poc_37.py 85 PASS/0 FAIL, verify_37.py 91 PASS/0 FAIL). Frontend testing confirms all user stories work end-to-end.
passed_tests: PATH A: Calibration from Delay Analytics panel - recommendation card with 'Kalibrasi sekarang' button opens dialog, fills cause + note >=10 chars, applies successfully, shows result + toast, closes dialog, card shows 'sudah diterapkan'

PATH B: Calibration from delay table row - 8 calibration buttons found, dialog opens, changes kind to 'Ubah durasi langkah', increases delta with plus button (1→2), explanation and preview table (14 rows) update correctly, applies with cause + note
PATH C: Rollback from history - 2 rollback buttons found, dialog opens, confirm button correctly disabled when note empty/short, enables after filling >=10 chars, successfully completed 2 rollbacks

PATH D: Number honesty fix verified - badge shows '+3 hari (geser rencana)' for wait_into_plan (NOT '0 hari'), history rows correct, fix confirmed in 4 places (rec badge, delay table badge, template badge, history chip)

PATH E: Render regression - all pages load without errors: Home (/), Work Hub (/work), Build Calendar (/build-calendar), Construction Progress (/construction), RAB/BoQ (/boq). 0 console errors (only normal WebSocket warnings)

PATH F: Baseline restoration verified - after all rollbacks: 'Usulan siap diterapkan' = 4 (baseline correct), 'Kalibrasi aktif' = 0 (baseline correct), RUMAH-9W = 60 days / 20 steps (baseline correct)
Session management: Access token lasts 24 hours in localStorage, single login session used for all tests as required
Dialog validation: Cause selection works, note validation (>=10 chars) works, apply button disabled until requirements met
Preview functionality: Preview table updates automatically when delta changes, explanation text updates, impact summary shows correct numbers
History panel: Shows calibration records with actor, timestamp, version changes, cause, note, and rollback status

success_percentage.backend: 100% (already proven by main agent: poc_37.py 85 PASS/0 FAIL, verify_37.py 91 PASS/0 FAIL, run_all_gates 18 gates PASS)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all 6 critical paths tested and passed: A-calibration from analytics, B-calibration from table, C-rollback with validation, D-number honesty fix, E-render regression, F-baseline restoration)
